question: What is cumulative frequency?
urdu_translation: cumulative frequency کیا ہے؟
A: The difference of consecutive frequencies / consecutive frequencies کا difference
B: The square of each frequency / ہر frequency کا square
C: The average of class limits / class limits کا average
D: The running total of frequencies / frequencies کا running total
correct_answer: D | The running total of frequencies / frequencies کا running total

question: In a cumulative frequency table, each cumulative frequency is obtained by:
urdu_translation: cumulative frequency table میں ہر cumulative frequency کیسے حاصل کی جاتی ہے؟
A: Adding the current frequency to the previous total / current frequency کو previous total میں add کر کے
B: Subtracting the current frequency / current frequency subtract کر کے
C: Multiplying all frequencies / تمام frequencies multiply کر کے
D: Dividing by the class width / class width سے divide کر کے
correct_answer: A | Adding the current frequency to the previous total / current frequency کو previous total میں add کر کے

question: If the first three frequencies are 4, 7 and 5, what is the third cumulative frequency?
urdu_translation: اگر first three frequencies 4، 7 اور 5 ہوں تو third cumulative frequency کیا ہوگی؟

question: The final cumulative frequency of a complete distribution equals:
urdu_translation: complete distribution کی final cumulative frequency کس کے برابر ہوتی ہے؟
A: The class width / class width
B: The mean / mean
D: The total number of observations / observations کی total number
correct_answer: D | The total number of observations / observations کی total number

question: A cumulative frequency polygon is also called an:
urdu_translation: cumulative frequency polygon کو اور کیا کہتے ہیں؟
A: Histogram / ہسٹوگرام
B: Ogive / اوگیو

question: An ogive plots cumulative frequencies against:
urdu_translation: ogive میں cumulative frequencies کو کس کے against plot کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Only class midpoints / صرف class midpoints
B: Individual raw values only / صرف individual raw values

question: Which two methods of constructing an ogive are described in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں ogive construct کرنے کے کون سے two methods ہیں؟
A: Mean and median methods / mean اور median methods
B: Bar and pie methods / bar اور pie methods
C: Direct and inverse methods / direct اور inverse methods
D: Less-than and more-than methods / less-than اور more-than methods
correct_answer: D | Less-than and more-than methods / less-than اور more-than methods

question: For a less-than ogive, which class boundaries are marked on the x-axis?
urdu_translation: less-than ogive کے لیے x-axis پر کون سی class boundaries mark کی جاتی ہیں؟
A: Lower class boundaries / lower class boundaries
B: Upper class boundaries / upper class boundaries
C: Class midpoints only / صرف class midpoints
correct_answer: B | Upper class boundaries / upper class boundaries

question: For a more-than ogive, which class boundaries are marked on the x-axis?
urdu_translation: more-than ogive کے لیے x-axis پر کون سی class boundaries mark کی جاتی ہیں؟
A: Upper class boundaries / upper class boundaries
B: Lower class boundaries / lower class boundaries
correct_answer: B | Lower class boundaries / lower class boundaries

question: Which quantity is marked on the y-axis while constructing an ogive?
urdu_translation: ogive construct کرتے وقت y-axis پر کون سی quantity mark کی جاتی ہے؟
A: Class width / class width
B: Raw score / raw score

question: After plotting the ogive points, they are connected using:
urdu_translation: ogive کے points plot کرنے کے بعد انہیں کیسے connect کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Only vertical lines / صرف vertical lines
B: A smooth freehand curve or straight line segments / smooth freehand curve یا straight line segments
D: Random broken lines / random broken lines
correct_answer: B | A smooth freehand curve or straight line segments / smooth freehand curve یا straight line segments

question: In a data set of 90 observations, what is the position of the median on an ogive?
urdu_translation: 90 observations کے data set میں ogive پر median کی position کیا ہوگی؟

urdu_translation: 90 observations کے data set میں ogive پر Q₁ کی position کیا ہوگی؟

question: If Q₁ = 56.9 and Q₃ = 75.6, find the interquartile range.

question: A box-and-whisker plot represents a data set using how many key values?
urdu_translation: box-and-whisker plot data set کو کتنی key values سے represent کرتا ہے؟
A: Three / تین
B: Four / چار

question: Which five values form a box-and-whisker plot?
urdu_translation: box-and-whisker plot کون سی five values سے بنتا ہے؟
A: Mean, mode, range, variance, frequency / mean، mode، range، variance، frequency
B: Minimum, Q₁, median, Q₃, maximum / minimum، Q₁، median، Q₃، maximum
C: Only quartiles and mean / صرف quartiles اور mean
D: Class limits and frequencies / class limits اور frequencies
correct_answer: B | Minimum, Q₁, median, Q₃, maximum / minimum، Q₁، median، Q₃، maximum

question: The box in a box plot represents the:
urdu_translation: box plot میں box کس quantity کو represent کرتا ہے؟
A: Complete range only / صرف complete range
B: Mean deviation / mean deviation

question: The line drawn inside the box represents the:
urdu_translation: box کے inside drawn line کیا represent کرتی ہے؟
A: Range / range
B: Mode / mode

question: The whiskers extend from the box to the:
urdu_translation: box plot میں whiskers box سے کس تک extend کرتی ہیں؟
A: Mean and mode / mean اور mode
B: Q₁ and Q₃ only / صرف Q₁ اور Q₃
C: Minimum and maximum values / minimum اور maximum values
D: First and last frequencies / first اور last frequencies
correct_answer: C | Minimum and maximum values / minimum اور maximum values

question: For the ordered data with minimum 2, Q₁ = 4.5, median = 11, Q₃ = 15 and maximum 18, what is the IQR?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل five-number summary کا IQR معلوم کریں: minimum = 2, Q₁ = 4.5, median = 11, Q₃ = 15, maximum = 18

question: A box plot has Q₁ = 12.6 and Q₃ = 55.6. Find its IQR.
urdu_translation: box plot میں Q₁ = 12.6 اور Q₃ = 55.6 ہیں۔ IQR معلوم کریں۔

question: A scatter diagram displays the relationship between:
urdu_translation: scatter diagram کس کے درمیان relationship دکھاتا ہے؟
A: One category only / صرف one category
B: Four quartiles / four quartiles
C: Two numerical variables / two numerical variables
D: Class boundaries only / صرف class boundaries
correct_answer: C | Two numerical variables / two numerical variables

question: In a scatter diagram, the independent variable is usually plotted on the:
urdu_translation: scatter diagram میں independent variable عموماً کس axis پر plot ہوتا ہے؟
A: Vertical y-axis / vertical y-axis
B: Both axes simultaneously / دونوں axes simultaneously

question: In a scatter diagram, the dependent variable is usually plotted on the:
urdu_translation: scatter diagram میں dependent variable عموماً کس axis پر plot ہوتا ہے؟
A: Horizontal x-axis / horizontal x-axis
B: Origin only / صرف origin
D: Class boundary axis / class boundary axis

question: A line drawn through a scatter diagram to represent the overall trend is called the:
urdu_translation: scatter diagram میں overall trend represent کرنے والی line کیا کہلاتی ہے؟
A: Ogive / ogive
B: Line of best fit / line of best fit
correct_answer: B | Line of best fit / line of best fit

question: When one variable increases as the other increases, the correlation is:
urdu_translation: جب ایک variable increase ہو اور دوسرا بھی increase ہو تو correlation کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: Negative / negative
B: Positive / positive

question: When one variable decreases as the other increases, the correlation is:
urdu_translation: جب ایک variable decrease ہو جبکہ دوسرا increase ہو تو correlation کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: Positive / positive
B: Negative / negative

question: When there is no consistent pattern between two variables, the correlation is:
urdu_translation: جب two variables کے درمیان کوئی consistent pattern نہ ہو تو correlation کیا ہوتی ہے؟
A: Zero correlation / zero correlation
B: Strong positive correlation / strong positive correlation
C: Strong negative correlation / strong negative correlation

question: Points lying very close to an upward-sloping line indicate:
urdu_translation: upward-sloping line کے بہت close points کیا indicate کرتے ہیں؟
A: Strong positive correlation / strong positive correlation
B: Weak negative correlation / weak negative correlation
D: Strong negative correlation / strong negative correlation
correct_answer: A | Strong positive correlation / strong positive correlation

question: The textbook line of best fit estimates a test score of 64% for 5.5 hours of revision. Which value is the estimate?
urdu_translation: textbook line of best fit 5.5 hours revision کے لیے test score estimate کرتی ہے۔ estimate کیا ہے؟

question: Measures of dispersion describe how data values are:
urdu_translation: measures of dispersion بتاتی ہیں کہ data values کیسے ہیں؟
A: Added to form frequency / frequency بنانے کے لیے add
B: Converted into categories / categories میں convert
C: Spread or scattered around a central value / central value کے around spread یا scattered
correct_answer: C | Spread or scattered around a central value / central value کے around spread یا scattered

question: Which formula gives the range R?
urdu_translation: range R کا formula کون سا ہے؟
A: R = H + L
B: R = H/L

question: Find the range of the data: 15, 22, 18, 30, 17, 25
urdu_translation: درج ذیل data کا range معلوم کریں: 15, 22, 18, 30, 17, 25

question: For grouped data, the range is found using the:
urdu_translation: grouped data کے range کے لیے کیا use کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Two middle frequencies / two middle frequencies
B: Mean and median / mean اور median
C: Quartile positions only / صرف quartile positions
D: Highest and lowest class boundaries / highest اور lowest class boundaries
correct_answer: D | Highest and lowest class boundaries / highest اور lowest class boundaries

question: Variance is the average of the squares of deviations from the:
urdu_translation: variance values کی deviations کے squares کا average ہے جو کس سے لی جاتی ہیں؟
A: Mode / mode
B: Range / range

question: Standard deviation is the:
urdu_translation: standard deviation کیا ہے؟
A: Square of the range / range کا square
B: Positive square root of variance / variance کا positive square root
C: Difference of quartiles / quartiles کا difference
correct_answer: B | Positive square root of variance / variance کا positive square root

question: A larger variance indicates that the data are:
urdu_translation: larger variance کیا indicate کرتی ہے؟
A: More tightly clustered / زیادہ tightly clustered
B: More spread out / زیادہ spread out
D: Without a mean / mean کے بغیر
correct_answer: B | More spread out / زیادہ spread out

question: A smaller standard deviation indicates:
urdu_translation: smaller standard deviation کیا indicate کرتی ہے؟
A: Greater consistency / زیادہ consistency
B: Greater spread / زیادہ spread
D: A larger range in every case / ہر case میں larger range

question: The variance of the data 13, 8, 4, 9, 7, 12, 10 is:
urdu_translation: درج ذیل data کی variance کیا ہے: 13, 8, 4, 9, 7, 12, 10

question: Two students have the same mean score. Their standard deviations are 2.83 and 5.25. Who is more consistent?
urdu_translation: two students کا mean same ہے۔ standard deviations 2.83 اور 5.25 ہیں۔ کون زیادہ consistent ہے؟
A: The student with standard deviation 2.83 / standard deviation 2.83 والا student
B: The student with standard deviation 5.25 / standard deviation 5.25 والا student
C: Both are equally consistent / دونوں equally consistent
D: Consistency cannot be compared / consistency compare نہیں ہو سکتی
correct_answer: A | The student with standard deviation 2.83 / standard deviation 2.83 والا student

question: What is the variance of a data set in which every value is 8?
